title: Function on the sign cube
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The corresponding function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ sends each sign vector to the value of $f$ at its inverse image under the binary-to-sign cube bijection.
